reviews.title: Not Worth It
reviews.text: I just passed 2200 days with reaching daily completion, all the level quests finished and maxed, and all plants collected. I like the cute plants and the little reminders. With all that I’m still level 20 and it has made me so tired that meaningful growth is not possible in this game

reviews.title: Subscribe or live with mediocrity
reviews.text: I love the idea of this app. However, I don’t love the idea of spending over $10 a month to water my plants and keep track of my water goals. I hate how often my tracking is interrupted by an ad break. For that reason I’m giving them a one star. Give us the option to purchase the app outright instead of being forced to subscribe

reviews.title: Unfair to put plants previously available for FREE behind paywall.
reviews.text: I have had Plant Nanny 2 ever since they got rid of the original Plant Nanny that was COMPLETELY free to use. When they introduced Plant Nanny 2 ALL of the plants were free, just like in Plant Nanny. And I grew ALL of the plants multiple times in order to unlock all of the creatures. But then they decided to turn what WAS a FREE and simple app into another money-grab “subscription” app and locked almost all of the plants I had already grown behind a paywall. It is bad enough that they ruined an app that is supposed to remind people to drink water by turning it into another subscription-based app, but why lock up the plants that HAD been free in the original version behind a paywall? Why couldn’t they have just left ALL of the plants that were ALREADY FREE alone and then create different plants that could be unlocked by paying for a subscription? It is NOT right that the majority of plants I had already grown became unavailable when they chose to ruin the app by turning it into another money-grab subscription app.

reviews.title: Takes too long
reviews.text: I loved this app when I first downloaded it, it helped me keep track of my water intake and would send me notifications to keep on track with my goals. The issue is the low reward, it takes forever to get your plant to grow and there’s no sense of reward / accomplishment with that then so it quickly becomes boring and I had to delete it.

reviews.title: Great concept, but too money-grabbing
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I love the concept of the app, and I’ve enjoyed it when I’ve been using it - the art is great, the plants are cute, the sounds and music are endearing - and it helps me track my water intake! 
It stops there, however. Every time you open the app or log a drink you get ads popping up, whether it’s AI generated slop from other companies or advertising their own premium service (waaaaaayyyyy too expensive btw, £70 a year for a tracking app is ridiculous imo) they are EVERYWHERE. There are ads posted all over the app anyway so pop up ads are even more frustrating, especially when they’re scam ads. It really ruins the experience of the whole thing… On top of all of this, though, the free version only gives you 6 plants, so the novelty is going to wear off pretty quickly if you aren’t going to pay premium for the extra plant species. 
It was fun whilst it lasted, and though I have 2 more plants I can grow, I’m not sure I’ll be sticking through ad hell to watch them bloom
